defect.summary: OP3'S ONE-RECORD QUANTUM SKIPPED A MOVE INTO UNDEFINEDNESS (T37 cond. 13; signature (b), RULED; NARROWED by the audit 2026-10-18 06:56Z): at a0d3017 oneRecordQuantum (index.ts:263) skipped a relabel whose AMI is null, so on AAB x YYY, where relabelling the lone B leaves ONE context class (below op3's arity gate, AMI undefined), the quantum read 0 and leg B ALARMed OP3_RESPONSE_FLATLINE at AMI 0. Ruled, the narrower reading: such a move only drops the table below the arity gate, so the table reads INELIGIBLE (CANNOT_ASSESS), not unbounded; the flat-signature ALARM stays readable wherever every context class holds two or more records.

Supersedes draft v1 (0a74faf, branch t39-op3-unresolvable: +Infinity quantum, UNRESOLVABLE at both boundaries). The quantum is computed once and T18's gate reads the same object.
